verdict.rationale: Greptile's security page documents that customers can self-host it in their own VPC or air-gapped environment, self-host or bring their own LLMs, turn off logging, and keep logs on customer servers only, which keeps code out of the vendor's hands. However, the same page reserves the right to aggregate and anonymize Customer Data and use it to train AI models, with no documented opt-out for the hosted service. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training guarantee or opt-out toggle for the hosted service, a statement that the de-identified-data training clause does not apply to self-hosted deployments, and independent corroboration.
